title: Audit event (C8)
description: One JSON object per line on a dedicated logger/appender shipped to the SIEM. Never contains argument values, tool results, secrets or confirmation codes; additionalProperties is false so such fields cannot be added by accident. Target system of broker events is carried in 'server' (mcp-<system>). The serializer must escape control characters, U+2028 and U+2029 in every string value.

clientRequestId.description: X-Request-Id sent by the AI client, recorded by the gateway only (C3). Untrusted, so limited to a log-safe alphabet (CC-031); the gateway drops a value that does not match instead of rejecting the call.

id.description: Resource id as the system knows it (Jira key, GitLab path, index name, page id). Free-form because ids of the five systems use different alphabets (slashes, dots, spaces in some service desks), but C0 and C1 control characters, DEL, U+2028, U+2029 and the bidirectional controls U+202A..U+202E and U+2066..U+2069 are excluded so the line-oriented SIEM format and log viewers cannot be misled (CC-031). The length limit counts UTF-16 code units (JSON Schema validators in Java and JavaScript); producers should keep ids below 512 characters. Independently of this, the audit JSON serializer must escape every control character and U+2028/U+2029.

parent.description: Parent as <Namespace>::<Type>::<id>, e.g. Jira::Project::ABC (C8 example format).

reason.description: Machine-readable reason, snake case. Known values: policy_forbid, not_granted, tool_disabled, user_confirmed, user_declined, confirmation_expired, credential_required, step_up_required, rate_limited. For event admin_change of the gateway's virtual server changes (CC-107): vs_created, vs_deleted, slug_taken, not_granted, invalid_request, virtual_server_limit, not_found_or_denied (the list of tools of a link is not a field of this schema). For event authentication it is the rejection code of the internal JWT vectors (missing_token, bad_signature, unknown_kid, alg_not_allowed, wrong_issuer, wrong_audience, expired, replayed_jti, service_token_not_allowed, tool_mismatch, invalid_claims, lifetime_too_long, not_yet_valid, request_id_mismatch, tool_missing, tool_not_allowed, test_key_not_allowed, malformed).

argsLength.description: Length in bytes of the serialized arguments; the only trace of arguments allowed in audit.

allOf.description: Rejected authentication (CC-071): emitted by a receiver of the internal JWT (server, broker). Closed list of fields (propertyNames): everything that comes from the claims of the unverified token (sub, username, client, tool, risk, resource, virtualServer, policyRevision, credentialType) is forbidden, and so is any part of the token. Carries the rejection code in reason.
